area: WP 3.1 (V3_MILESTONES.md §9): kernel Schema and Order, and the differential against v2's read side
summary: Nothing of WP 3.1 exists yet. kernel/ has no Schema.cs, Order.cs or ColumnType.cs. The row is at V3_MILESTONES.md:581, Appendix F budgets Schema.cs at 520 and Order.cs at 180 (V3_MILESTONES.md:1128-1129), and WP 2.1 defines ColumnType at V3_MILESTONES.md:520. Everything Schema.Of needs is already in the Element model that io/Ssdt.cs:634 ModelObjects reads. I measured it on DacFx 170.5.96 against the dbchange-sql container: the copy's tables, columns with facets, alias types, primary keys, uniques, foreign keys (actions, Disabled), checks, defaults (including NEXT VALUE FOR), identity seed and increment, computed and period columns, the temporal history link, and triggers. Two facts are not in the model: constraint trust, and whether a column is a column set. v2's CLI cannot write the read-side catalog. Its only use of the read side is `projection diff ... live:<conn> --format json` (archive/v2/src/Projection.Cli/Faces/Diff.fs:20), which prints table names; I ran it. So the oracle has to be v2's library pair `ReadSide.readSchema` (ReadSide.fs:1969) then `CatalogCodec.serialize` (CatalogCodec.fs:428). A 20-line F# program builds it from the archive with the 9.0.314 SDK in 50 s, with `--artifacts-path` so no bin/obj lands in archive/. I prototyped the whole differential in scratch. I applied a draft sample change to the golden project, built it against dist/dbchange, published it under the pipeline profile, then read the copy with v2's read side and with v3's io/Ssdt.ReadModel. Both reduce to the same 102 fact lines (75 chars at most). A second database with exotic types, sparse columns, a column set, an untrusted FK, a disabled FK and trigger, and a temporal table gives 146 identical facts.

items.name: ColumnType: WP 2.1's typed column type, defined now in kernel/ColumnType.cs so WP 3.1 does not start M2
items.evidence: V3_MILESTONES.md:520 (WP 2.1: 'read into a typed ColumnType (the type name and those five facets, with no ordering between types) that io writes as TRY_CONVERT's target type and WP 3.1's Schema reuses'); kernel/ holds no such type. Measured on a copy (DacFx 170.5.96): a Column element's relationship DataType targets `DataType [int]` (one-part key: a system type, NOT an element of the model, since io/Ssdt.cs:654 reads only user-defined objects) or `DataType [dbo].[ShortCode]` (an alias: an element with UddtLength=6, UddtIsMax, UddtPrecision, UddtScale, UddtNullable=false, SqlDataType=Unknown and relationship Type -> `DataType [nvarchar]`). Facets are properties Length/Precision/Scale (Value.Integer, 0 when not applicable; datetime2 default Scale=7, time(0) Scale=0, float Precision=53, real Precision=0, money Precision=0), IsMax (Value.Boolean), Collation (Value.Text 'Latin1_General_CS_AS' or Value.Null). An alias-typed column carries Length=0 and its own Nullable=false.

items.name: The differential test, the facts both readers share, and the committed facts
items.evidence: Prototype in scratch (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-outsystems-ddl-exporter/17755096-5809-5c10-a22d-d46e8371455a/scratchpad/scout/wp31/facts.py). It reduces v2's JSON and v3's elements to one fact grammar. On the golden copy with the draft change both give the same 102 lines (expected file: …/scout/wp31/probe/golden.facts); on the exotic probe database, 146 = 146. v2's JSON shape: modules[].kinds[] with physical{schema,table} and attributes[] (ssKey, column{columnName,isNullable}, type: Integer|Decimal|Text|Boolean|DateTime|Date|Time|Binary|Guid, length (-1 MAX → null), precision, scale (Decimal only), isPrimaryKey, isIdentity, defaultValue{kind,value}, computed{expression,isPersisted}, sqlStorage{kind: RowVersion|SqlVariant}). Also references[] (sourceAttribute ssKey, targetKind ssKey, one per FK column, name synthesized FK_<table>_<column>, onDelete always NoAction: ReadSide.fs:1189), indexes[] (non-PK, unique constraints included, isUnique, columns[]{attribute,direction}; no filter, no includes: ReadSide.fs:361), columnChecks[] (definition, with outer parentheses; system names), triggers[] (name, isDisabled), and sequences. Collation and identity seed are never read (ReadSide.fs:510, :514). Defaults are normalized by PhysicalSchema.normalizeDefault (archive/v2/src/Projection.Core/PhysicalSchema.fs:462); a bit default arrives as BooleanLit true/false. INFORMATION_SCHEMA facets: money (19,4), smallmoney (10,4), float 53, real 24, text 2147483647, ntext 1073741823, image 2147483647, sql_variant length 0, xml and MAX null. Existing idioms: copy plus publish plus extract (tests/Io.Tests/CopyTests.cs:119-126: PublishProfiles.Load, LocalServer.Create, copy.Publish, DacFx.Extract); SqlServerFixture.RepositoryRoot (tests/Io.Tests/SqlServerFixture.cs:55); Programs.InRepository and Command.Environment (tests/Budgets.Tests/Programs.cs, linked into Io.Tests); the bless precedent DBCHANGE_BLESS=1 (tests/Budgets.Tests/ContractTests.cs:49); the categories fast|fixture|build only (tests/Budgets.Tests/NoSkips.cs:66).
items.remaining:
tests/Io.Tests/ReadSideFacts.cs: internal static class ReadSideFacts { public static SortedArray<string> Of(Schema schema); public static SortedArray<string> Of(JsonNode v2Catalog); public static SortedArray<string> Committed(string change) /* tests/Golden/changes/<change>/read-side.txt, lines starting '#' skipped */; public static void Bless(string change, SortedArray<string> facts); internal static string Stripped(string expression) /* v2's normalizeDefault: trim, then remove a balanced outer pair of parentheses repeatedly */ }.

The grammar, one fact per line, names quoted as Name.ToString quotes them, sorted ordinally: `table [s].[t]`; `column [s].[t].[c] <ordinal> <type> null|not-null[ primary-key][ identity][ rowversion][ variant]`; for a computed column `column [s].[t].[c] <ordinal> computed null|not-null` and `computed [s].[t].[c] persisted|virtual <Stripped expression>`; `default [s].[t].[c] <Stripped expression>` (v2's BooleanLit as 1 or 0); `reference [s].[t].[c] -> [s].[t]` (one line per leg); `unique [s].[t] ([c][ desc], ...)` (unique constraints and unique indexes, key order; v2's isUnique indexes); `check [s].[t] <Stripped expression>`; `trigger [s].[t] <name> enabled|disabled`.

Type from Schema's stored ColumnType (system name lower-cased): tinyint/smallint/int/bigint → Integer; bit → Boolean; decimal/numeric → Decimal(p,s); money → Decimal(19,4); smallmoney → Decimal(10,4); float → Decimal(Precision, 53 when 0); real → Decimal(24); char/varchar/nchar/nvarchar → Text(n|max); xml → Text(max); text → Text(2147483647); ntext → Text(1073741823); sql_variant → Text(0) variant; binary/varbinary → Binary(n|max); image → Binary(2147483647); rowversion/timestamp → Binary(max) rowversion; uniqueidentifier → Guid; date → Date; time → Time; datetime/datetime2/smalldatetime/datetimeoffset → DateTime. Generated columns use their Type, as stored columns do. v2's side: Text/Binary(length or max), Decimal(precision[,scale]).

The file header (lines starting '# ') lists what both readers do not share, each with its reason. FK names, target columns, actions and Disabled: v2 synthesizes FK_<table>_<column> names and writes NoAction. Trust: the model holds none, S9. Names of checks, uniques and defaults: v2 reads system names the model leaves unnamed. Identity seed, collation, sparse, exact storage type: v2 reads none. Non-unique indexes, filters and included columns. Temporal flags. A computed column's type. Sequences.

items.name: CI: v2's read side runs on every push in the Docker SQL lane; the other fixture lanes check v3 against the committed facts
items.evidence: .github/workflows/dbchange.yml:62-84 (sql-ubuntu job: setup-dotnet from global.json, restore, build, `bash ci/sql.sh up`, `dotnet test --filter Category=fixture`, timeout 20 min). The LocalDB (windows) and outbound-denied jobs cannot restore v2's packages or lack .NET 9. Cost measured: about 50 s build plus restore. The archive is frozen, so an actions/cache keyed on hashFiles('archive/v2/src/Projection.Core/**','archive/v2/src/Projection.Adapters.Sql/**','archive/v2/src/Projection.Targets.Json/**','ci/readside.sh') would make it a few seconds.
items.remaining: In sql-ubuntu only: add a second `actions/setup-dotnet@v4` with `dotnet-version: 9.0.314` after the global.json one. Before the fixture tests, add the step `name: v2's read side, built from the archive (WP 3.1's oracle)`, `run: echo "DBCHANGE_READSIDE=$(bash ci/readside.sh)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"` (optionally behind actions/cache on .dbchange/readside). The windows-LocalDB and outbound-denied jobs stay unchanged: they run the same test, which checks Schema.Of against the committed facts, and their lane does not run v2. Write a DECISIONS.md line: WP 3.1's oracle is v2's read side through ReadSide.readSchema and CatalogCodec.serialize, because v2's CLI writes no read-side catalog; it runs in the Docker SQL lane, and the committed facts stand for it elsewhere. Correct V3_MILESTONES.md:581's Done-when to say the same ('the catalog v2's read side writes as JSON for the same copy (ReadSide.readSchema, then CatalogCodec.serialize, built from the archive by ci/readside.sh)').

risks: Trust state is not in DacFx's model. A WITH NOCHECK foreign key and a WITH NOCHECK check extract with no property saying so; only Disabled is modeled. Schema therefore holds no trust, and the facts leave it out. WP 3.5's trust step must read sys.foreign_keys.is_not_trusted and sys.check_constraints.is_not_trusted through SqlServer.Measure. S9 decides whether trust can come through a schema read.

A column set (XML COLUMN_SET FOR ALL_SPARSE_COLUMNS) cannot be told from an ordinary nullable xml column: io/ModelTypes.cs:20 collapses SqlColumnSet into Column and no property marks it. PLT-36 needs the planter to leave it out of the INSERT list. WP 3.8 needs either an io change (record the serialized type, for example as a property) or a catalog read of sys.columns.is_column_set.

The v2 half of the differential runs only where DBCHANGE_READSIDE is set, which is the Docker SQL lane. Elsewhere the test checks v3 against the committed facts. That is weaker than a run of v2 on every lane, and a reviewer reading NoSkips' spirit may object. The alternative is a separate test class excluded from the LocalDB and denied lanes by filter. Either way the Docker lane must keep setting the variable. A fast check that dbchange.yml's sql-ubuntu job runs ci/readside.sh would make that drift loud.

LocalDB on Windows normalizes check and default text and reports nullability through SQL Server 2022 as the container does, as far as the docs say. It was not measured here. If the LocalDB lane differs, the committed facts will fail there, which is a real finding: do not loosen the grammar to hide it.

A non-persisted computed column always reads Nullable=true from DacFx, while v2 reads SQL Server's inferred nullability. They agreed on LEN(Code) and Id*2, but an ISNULL(...) computed column would differ. Keep such a column out of the fixture, or record that difference in the header.

v2's read side fails the whole read on a type its SqlStorageType.ofSqlType table lacks (hierarchyid, geography, geometry, CLR types: sqlTypeCorrespondence.unknown). The fixture must avoid them, though Schema.Of must still read them, since PLT-24, PLT-25 and PLT-28 plant or stop on them.

The register bans words in test names, error messages and documents (ci/register.json): projection, quotient, probe, walk, engine, writer, delta, norm, lens, plane, binding, stub, directive, and View/Watch exact. Do not name the test-side element builder a 'writer' or the fact grammar a 'quotient'. Do not call Order's error member `Refusal` (a retired exact term). Each new error code (model.unresolved, model.identity, synthetic-copy.cycle) needs a driver in tests/Budgets.Tests/Register/ErrorPaths.cs and a one-sentence imperative remedy that leads with a verb.

Appendix F's Schema.cs at 520 lines exceeds the 500-line code-file rule the build loop holds. Put ColumnType in kernel/ColumnType.cs (about 60) and keep Schema.cs at or under 500. The total stays within the 520 plus 180 plan, and kernel is at 2,365 of 6,800.

Order defers every optional reference inside a cyclic component, not a minimal set. That is simple and deterministic, but it can plan a pass-2 UPDATE the planter did not strictly need. State it in Order.cs's summary. Changing it later changes WP 3.8's planted rows (D1).

Expressions in a package keep the text as written, while a copy's are SQL Server's normalized text ('[Total]>=(0)'). Schema keeps whichever it was given. WP 3.8 must not compare a package's expression with a copy's.

ColumnType lands before M2, so WP 2.1 inherits it. If WP 2.1's Fits needs the declared and the stored type both, use ColumnType.Of for the declared type and Stored for the stored one, as specified. Do not change the record's fields when M2 opens.

WP 2.6 (M2) will turn tests/Golden/changes/ into the operation corpus with expected predictions per folder. declare-what-the-planter-reads is a fixture, not an operation, so WP 2.6 must exempt or relocate it.

The fixture's constraints must stay ones the golden post-deploy seed satisfies: it plants an orphan Order.CustomerId 999 and a duplicate Product.Code. Declaring FK_Order_Customer or a unique Product.Code would fail the copy's publish.
